title: Random Student ID
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N; N is an integer.; S_i is a string of length at least 1 consisting of lowercase English letters.; The sum of lengths of the given strings is at most 5 \times 10^5.; i \neq j \Rightarrow S_i \neq S_j
